[In 1762 Jean Calas, a Protestant of Toulouse, was done to death by torture on the wheel on the false charge of having slain his son, a suicide. His widow and children were put to the torture to extort a confession, in utter lack of evidence.

arxiv-2007-03196.title: ASGN: An Active Semi-supervised Graph Neural Network for Molecular Property Prediction DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 Conference: The 26th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD’20); Aug. 22–27, 2020; San Diego, CA The 26th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Da
arxiv-2007-03196.creator: Zhongkai Hao 1 , Chengqiang Lu 1 ,Zhenya Huang 1 , Hao Wang 1 ,Zheyuan Hu 1 , Qi Liu 1,∗ , Enhong Chen 1 , Cheekong Lee 2
arxiv-2007-03196.description: Abstract . Molecular property prediction (e.g., energy) is an essential problem in chemistry and biology. Unfortunately, many supervised learning methods usually suffer from the problem of scarce labeled molecules in the chemical space, where such property labels are generally obtained by Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculation which is extremely computational costly.

arxiv-2007-08197.title: How Inclusive Are Wikipedia’s Hyperlinks in Articles Covering Polarizing Topics?
arxiv-2007-08197.creator: Cristina Menghini, Aris Anagnostopoulos, Eli Upfal
arxiv-2007-08197.description: Abstract Wikipedia relies on an extensive review process to verify that the content of each individual page is unbiased and presents a “neutral point of view.” Less attention has been paid to possible biases in the hyperlink structure of Wikipedia, which has a significant influence on the user’s exploration process when visiting more than one page.

arxiv-2211-16706.title: A 𝟑 × 𝟑 \boldsymbol{3\times 3} Lax Form for the 𝒒 \boldsymbol{q} -Painlevé Equation of Type 𝑬 𝟔 \boldsymbol{E_{6}}
arxiv-2211-16706.creator: Kanam PARK
arxiv-2211-16706.description: Abstract For the q q -Painlevé equation with affine Weyl group symmetry of type E 6 ( 1 ) E_{6}^{(1)} , a 2 × 2 2\times 2 matrix Lax form and a second order scalar lax form were known. We give a new 3 × 3 3\times 3 matrix Lax form and a third order scalar equation related to it.

The authors also thank Prof. Tapio Rajala and Prof. Qingshan Zhou for pointing out some typos in the first version of manuscript and m

arxiv-2401-13263.description: Abstract . Impressed by the remarkable results about the characterization of (global) Sobolev-Poincaré imbedding domains in [ 6 ] by Buckley and Koskela. In this article, we give characterizations to local Sobolev-Poincaré imbedding domains. The main result reads as below.

arxiv-2403-14750.title: Fast likelihood-free inference in the LSS Stage IV era
arxiv-2403-14750.creator: and Christoph Weniger
arxiv-2403-14750.description: Abstract Forthcoming large-scale structure (LSS) Stage IV surveys will provide us with unprecedented data to probe the nature of dark matter and dark energy. However, analysing these data with conventional Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods will be challenging, due to the increase in the number of nuisance parameters and the presence of intractable likelihoods.

arxiv-2409-00083.title: On-device Learning of EEGNet-based Network For Wearable Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interface Conference: Proceedings of the 2024 ACM International Symposium on Wearable Computers; October 5–9, 2024; Melbourne, VIC, Australia Proceedings of the 2024 ACM International Symposium on Wearable Computers
arxiv-2409-00083.creator: Sizhen Bian, Pixi Kang, Julian Moosmann, Mengxi Liu, Pietro Bonazzi, Roman Rosipal, Michele Magno
arxiv-2409-00083.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sizhen Bian, Pixi Kang, Julian Moosmann, Mengxi Liu, Pietro Bonazzi, Roman Rosipal, Michele Magno. Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) have garnered significant interest across various domains, including rehabilitation and robotics. Despite advancements in neural network-based EEG decoding, maintaining performance across diverse user populations remains challenging due to feature distribution drift. This paper presents an effective approach to address this challenge by implementing a lightweight and efficient on-device learning engine for wearable motor imagery recognition.

arxiv-2505-02624.title: Ferroelectric Properties and Topological Textures in PbTiO 3 from a Second-Principles Open-Source interatomic potential
arxiv-2505-02624.creator: Louis Bastogne, Philippe Ghosez
arxiv-2505-02624.description: Abstract We introduce an open-source, fully atomistic second-principles interatomic potential for lead titanate (PbTiO 3 ), a benchmark ferroelectric material known for its strong polarization and high-temperature phase transitions. While density functional theory excels at capturing atomic-scale behavior, it remains computationally prohibitive for large-scale simulations required to explore complex phenomena.

arxiv-2506-03516.title: SemNav: A Model-Based Planner for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation Using Vision-Foundation Models
arxiv-2506-03516.creator: Arnab Debnath, Gregory J. Stein, Jana Košecká
arxiv-2506-03516.description: Abstract Object goal navigation is a fundamental task in embodied AI, where an agent is instructed to locate a target object in an unexplored environment. Traditional learning-based methods rely heavily on large-scale annotated data or require extensive interaction with the environment in a reinforcement learning setting, often failing to generalize to novel environments and limiting scalability.

arxiv-2508-11849.title: LocoMamba: Vision-Driven Locomotion via End-to-End Deep Reinforcement Learning with Mamba
arxiv-2508-11849.creator: Yinuo Wang, Gavin Tao
arxiv-2508-11849.description: Abstract Applying deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to quadrupedal robots is promising for obstacle negotiation, terrain locomotion, and real-world deployment. Existing methods either train blind agents that sacrifice foresight or adopt cross-modal fusion architectures with limitations; even Transformer-based models still suffer from the quadratic cost of self-attention.

arxiv-2510-15132.title: A Simple Method for PMF Estimation on Large Supports
arxiv-2510-15132.creator: Alex Shtoff alexander.shtoff@tii.ae
arxiv-2510-15132.description: Abstract We study nonparametric estimation of a probability mass function (PMF) on [ N ] = { 0 , 1 , 2 , … , N − 1 } [N]=\{0,1,2,\dots,N-1\} from samples when N N can be large and the true PMF is often multi-modal and heavy-tailed.

arxiv-2510-18218.title: DualHash: A Stochastic Primal-Dual Algorithm with Theoretical Guarantee for Deep Hashing
arxiv-2510-18218.creator: Luxuan Li, Xiao Wang, Chunfeng Cui
arxiv-2510-18218.description: Abstract Deep hashing converts high-dimensional feature vectors into compact binary codes, enabling efficient large-scale retrieval. A fundamental challenge in deep hashing stems from the discrete nature of quantization in generating the codes. W-type regularizations, such as | | z | − 1 | ||z|-1| , have been proven effective as they encourage variables toward binary values.

europmc-pmc4881593.creator: Calzadilla Bertot L, Adams LA.
europmc-pmc4881593.description: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is the most prevalent form of chronic liver disease in the world, paralleling the epidemic of obesity and Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). NAFLD exhibits a histological spectrum, ranging from "bland steatosis" to the more aggressive...

pmc-10505608.title: Opening a window to skin biomarkers for diabetes stage with optoacoustic mesoscopy
pmc-10505608.creator: Hailong He, Nikolina-Alexia Fasoula, Angelos Karlas, Murad Omar, Juan Aguirre, Jessica Lutz, Michael Kallmayer, Martin Füchtenbusch, Hans-Henning Eckstein, Annette Ziegler, Vasilis Ntziachristos
pmc-10505608.description: Being the largest and most accessible organ of the human body, the skin could offer a window to diabetes-related complications on the microvasculature. However, skin microvasculature is typically assessed by histological analysis, which is not suited for applications to large populations or longitudinal studies.

pmc-11286177.title: Trends in rate of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and associated morbidities in Canada: a population-based study (2012–2021)
pmc-11286177.creator: Susie Dzakpasu, Chantal Nelson, Elizabeth K Darling, Wesley Edwards, Phil A Murphy, Heather Scott, Michiel Van den Hof, Joel G Ray
pmc-11286177.description: Background:Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) are a leading cause of severe maternal morbidity (SMM). We sought to explore trends in HDP and related morbidity outcomes in Canada.Methods:In this retrospective population-based study, we used hospital discharge data from Canada, excluding Quebec, to identify females who had an HDP diagnosis during a birth admission between 2012 and 2021.

pmc-11663550.title: Improving rice grain shape through upstream ORF editing-mediated translation regulation
pmc-11663550.creator: Qingqing Yang, Wenjie Zhu, Xu Tang, Yuechao Wu, Guanqing Liu, Dongsheng Zhao, Qiaoquan Liu, Yong Zhang, Tao Zhang
pmc-11663550.description: Upregulating gene expression by disturbing or destroying the upstream ORF of target genes is an efficient strategy for improving rice grain traits. Dear Editor, Rice (Oryza sativa) is vital for global food security and human health, influenced by its yield and quality.

pmc-11692495.title: PERCEIVED BENEFITS OF TREATMENTS OF ALZHEIMER’S DISEASE AND RELATED DEMENTIAS FOR COST-EFFECTIVENESS ESTIMATES
pmc-11692495.creator: Faika Zanjani, Madeline McIntyre, Tracey Gendron, Eline van den Broek-Altenburg
pmc-11692495.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to identify important non-Quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) benefits of novel Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementia (AD/ADRD) treatments. Cost-effectiveness analysis of AD/ADRD is mostly based on QALYs gained. However, other benefits in the International Society for Pharmacoeconomics and Outcomes Research value flower, such as severity of disease, hope, and option value are not included.

pmc-11700653.title: Flowtigs: Safety in flow decompositions for assembly graphs
pmc-11700653.creator: Francisco Sena, Eliel Ingervo, Shahbaz Khan, Andrey Prjibelski, Sebastian Schmidt, Alexandru Tomescu
pmc-11700653.description: SummaryA decomposition of a network flow is a set of weighted walks whose superposition equals the flow. In this article, we give a simple and linear-time-verifiable complete characterization (flowtigs) of walks that are safe in such general flow decompositions, i.e., that are subwalks of any possible flow decomposition.

pmc-12437006.title: Training of Psychiatry and Child Psychiatry Residents : Ethical Aspects
pmc-12437006.creator: S Bourgou, R Ghachem, S Halayem, G Amira
pmc-12437006.description: IntroductionEthical practices are fundamental to the training and professional development of psychiatry and child psychiatry residents. However, challenges such as stigmatization, discrimination, and ethical dilemmas in clinical and research settings can impact the quality of their training experience.Objectives To assess the degree of exposure of residents to stigmatization during their residency training.

pmc-12641773.title: Exploring the Impact of Nanotherapeutics on Histone H3 and H4 Acetylation Enrichment in Cancer Epigenome: A Systematic Scoping Synthesis
pmc-12641773.creator: Milad Shirvaliloo, Sepideh Khoee, Samideh Khoei, Roghayeh Sheervalilou, Parisa Mohammad Hosseini, Reza Afzalipour, Sakine Shirvalilou
pmc-12641773.description: Background/Objectives: Histone acetylation regulates gene expression and plays a key role in cancer pathophysiology. Nanotherapeutics are known to modulate histone acetylation and influence cancer progression. This systematic scoping review examines the effects of nanotherapeutics on histone acetylation enrichment across multiple cancers.

pmc-13120901.title: Spatial equity-oriented accessibility assessment and optimal allocation of older adult care facilities in Beijing’s central urban area
pmc-13120901.creator: Jianyi Huang, Hongjie Wang
pmc-13120901.description: IntroductionPopulation aging is a pressing global public health challenge. In aging-concentrated urban central areas, accelerated population aging has worsened the mismatch between supply and demand, irrational spatial layout, and inadequate accessibility of older adult care resources.MethodsTo improve public service equity, this study took Beijing’s central urban area as the research object.

pmc-13377064.title: LNP-based delivery of a Toll-like receptor 9 agonist elicits potent adjuvant effects and antitumor immunity
pmc-13377064.creator: Yarong Zeng, Jialin Xu, Feng Han, Sibo Zhang, Rong Su, Yufang Li, Renfei Gao, Xiuli Zhang, Lizhi Zhou, Tingting Li, Hai Yu, Qingbing Zheng, Ningshao Xia, Shaowei Li, Ying Gu
pmc-13377064.description: The success of therapeutic cancer vaccines hinges on overcoming the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) and activating robust, durable cellular immunity. Here, we engineered a highly translatable vaccine adjuvant delivery system (LNPC) by integrating the Toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9) agonist CpG with the FDA-approved ionizable lipid ALC-0315.

pmc-13430015.title: LINGO1-targeted antibody-drug conjugates improve efficacy and tolerability of antineoplastic therapies in Ewing sarcoma models
pmc-13430015.creator: Zhichuan Zhu, Yusha Liu, Yu Deng, Zhijun Li, Albert S. Baldwin, Pengda Liu
pmc-13430015.description: We reported LINGO1 as a potential marker on Ewing sarcoma cells that could enable targeted drug delivery, improving treatment effectiveness while reducing side effects. To the Editor: Ewing sarcoma is an aggressive and rare pediatric cancer that develops in bones and soft tissues. Chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and surgery remain the first-line therapy for patients (1).

pmc-13435504.title: A dual-pronged strategy: multi-bioactive nanoplatform synergizes ROS antidote and iron stabilization to protect against liver ischemia-reperfusion injury
pmc-13435504.creator: Jie Dong, Pengqi Zhu, Caifang Gao, Qian Wang, Jin Zhang, Yahong Han, Ru Feng, Tianfeng Chen, Jinghua Sun, Ruiping Zhang
pmc-13435504.description: Liver ischemia-reperfusion injury (LIRI) is a severe and nearly unavoidable complication in hepatectomy and liver transplantation, accompanied by intense oxidative stress and ferroptosis. Traditional clinical therapies often face challenges such as poor bioavailability, short circulation time, and low stability, which restrict their efficacy in regulating complex pathological microenvironments.

pmc-13574566.title: The ImproveCareNow Registry: Prediction of different remission rates in pediatric ulcerative colitis
pmc-13574566.creator: Jonathan Van Hecke, Gigi Veereman, Koen Huysentruyt, Lucas Wauters, Jeremy Adler, Shehzad Saeed, Elisabeth De Greef, and the ImproveCareNow Pediatric IBD Learning Health System
pmc-13574566.description: ObjectivesIdentifying predictors of clinical remission in pediatric ulcerative colitis (UC) will impact the therapeutic approach. We aimed to predict time to first (TFR), corticosteroid‐free (TCSFR, ≥3 months corticosteroid withdrawal), and sustained remission (TSR, ≥6 months).MethodsThis retrospective study analyzed de‐identified prospectively collected data from 2383 patients enrolled in ImproveCareNow (2007–2023). We included UC patients under 18 years at diagnosis.

pmc-13651391.title: Targeting the gut microbiome: an integrated probiotic and prebiotic strategy for polycystic ovary syndrome management
pmc-13651391.creator: Muchu Ni, Qin Wang, Tao Ye, Hongyan Lei, Yongzhou Wang, Yuan Yuan
pmc-13651391.description: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a prevalent endocrine-metabolic disorder in which gut dysbiosis acts as a key environmental driver. This review synthesizes how probiotics and prebiotics remodel the gut ecosystem and ameliorate PCOS through multi-pathway mechanisms:restoring intestinal barrier function, modulating microbial metabolites (e.g., short-chain fatty acids(SCFAs), bile acids(BAs)), attenuating chronic inflammation, and regulating androgen metabolism.
